bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
root=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
w="$root/.worktrees/issue7-room-build-classify-7b9cf44"
test ! -e "$w" || exit 73
git -C "$root" cat-file -e 7b9cf44f4c6279cfe6c2525afac94971ed88865f^{commit} || exit 75
git -C "$root" worktree add --detach "$w" 7b9cf44f4c6279cfe6c2525afac94971ed88865f >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 76
cleanup(){ git -C "$root" worktree remove --force "$w" >/dev/null 2>&1 || :; }
trap cleanup EXIT
cd "$w"
log=$(mktemp)
trap 'rm -f "$log"; cleanup' EXIT
if docker build --network=host --pull=false --progress=plain --target build -f artifacts/bot/deploy/Dockerfile.gaybbs -t gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:roommig-build-7b9cf44 . >"$log" 2>&1; then exit 0; fi
if grep -q 'src/db/migrate.ts:' "$log"; then exit 81; fi
if grep -qi 'unexpected end of file' "$log"; then exit 82; fi
if grep -qi 'unexpected .*token' "$log"; then exit 83; fi
if grep -qi 'Could not resolve' "$log"; then exit 84; fi
if grep -qi 'ERR_PNPM' "$log"; then exit 85; fi
if grep -qi 'no space left on device\|ENOSPC' "$log"; then exit 86; fi
if grep -qi 'ERROR.*network\|connection reset\|timeout' "$log"; then exit 87; fi
if grep -qi 'error:.*migrate' "$log"; then exit 88; fi
if grep -qi 'failed to solve' "$log"; then exit 89; fi
exit 90
